description: This file defines a React component named ShelfCarousel used for displaying a carousel of books with functionality to filter the displayed books based on search text. It includes subcomponents for individual book display and an 'Add Book' button, managing the display of a limited set of books with filtering capabilities.

classes.name: ShelfCarousel
classes.description: Main React component managing the display and filtering of a bookshelf carousel.

methods.name: filterBooks
methods.description: Filters the books in state based on the current searchText, returning books whose titles include the search text.

methods.name: renderShelfBook
methods.description: Renders a list of ShelfBook components for the first up to 6 books in the provided array.
